decisions.reason: The vegan superfood drink sits farthest from the firm's engineering and waste-conversion knowledge, so after several years with no visible presence the firm cannot readily read consumer-market feedback or improve the product with its R&D, and its resources are better redirected to core technology ventures.

The modular waste-to-energy extensions build directly on the firm's plant engineering, automation and prototyping know-how, so it can assimilate customer results and refine the models despite reduced visibility.

The waste-oil-to-energy plant remains a flagship rooted in the firm's core energy-from-waste knowledge, and in-house R&D and university cooperation give it the capacity to keep developing it, especially as energy-security demand rises.
